title: Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Metric Learning for Cross-Head Attention in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.13261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we propose Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Cross-Head Attention (DAMCHA), a simple and effective attention mechanism that generalizes Multi-Head Attention (MHA) through the lens of metric learning. Standard MHA implicitly learns a static, head-wise Euclidean similarity corresponding to the diagonal blocks of a unified cross-head metric matrix, discarding all off-diagonal interactions across heads. DAMCHA addresses this limitation via two key innovations. First, it learns the full cross-head metric matrix, inducing a Mahalanobis-like similarity that explicitly captures inter-head interactions beyond the restricted block-diagonal structure of MHA. Second, it parameterizes the metric matrix as an input-dependent function, enabling the attention geometry to dynamically adapt to the intrinsic manifold structure of the data rather than remaining fixed after training. translated_title: 面向Transformer跨头注意力的数据自适应马氏度量学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了数据自适应马氏跨头注意力（DAMCHA），这是一种简单而有效的注意力机制，从度量学习的视角对多头注意力（MHA）进行了泛化。标准MHA隐式地学习一种静态的、逐头的欧氏相似度，其对应于统一跨头度量矩阵的对角块，从而丢弃了所有跨头的非对角交互。DAMCHA通过两项关键创新解决了这一局限：首先，它学习完整的跨头度量矩阵，诱导出一种类似马氏距离的相似度，显式地捕捉超出MHA受限块对角结构之外的头间交互；其次，它将度量矩阵参数化为依赖输入的函数，使注意力几何结构能够动态适应数据的内在流形结构，而不是在训练结束后保持固定。此外，作者还引入了有原则的正则化策略（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出DAMCHA注意力机制，通过学习完整的、依赖输入的跨头马氏度量矩阵来泛化多头注意力，显式捕捉头间交互，并使注意力几何结构随数据动态自适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DAMCHA, an attention mechanism that generalizes Multi-Head Attention by learning a full, input-dependent cross-head Mahalanobis metric matrix, explicitly capturing inter-head interactions and dynamically adapting the attention geometry to the intrinsic structure of the data.
